title: Plux analytics: crash-free sessions and error rates
description: Crash-free sessions and Plux error rates per release, plugin and page (ANL-020).

list.name: organization
list.label: Organisation ID
list.description: The organisation UUID. Row-level security binds every query to it (SRV-022).

list.name: app
list.label: App
list.description: The apps of the organisation with rollups.

list.name: release
list.label: Release sequence
list.description: The release sequences of the selected apps with rollups.

panels.title: Crash-free sessions (approx.)
panels.description: 1 minus fatal_error events per session_start event, floored at 0. An approximation: a session with two fatal errors counts twice. The fatal_error event is not yet in the telemetry catalogue, so the value is empty until it is ingested.

panels.title: Plux errors per 1000 sessions
panels.description: Error events per 1000 session_start events in the range.

panels.title: Plux errors per 1000 sessions over time
panels.description: Error events per 1000 session_start events, per bucket.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT set_config('plux.organization_id', ${organization:sqlstring}, false);
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(r.bucket, $__interval),
  1000.0 * SUM(r.events) FILTER (WHERE r.event_name = 'error') / NULLIF(SUM(r.events) FILTER (WHERE r.event_name = 'session_start'), 0) AS "Errors per 1000 sessions"
FROM analytics_rollups r
WHERE r.organization_id = NULLIF(${organization:sqlstring}, '')::uuid
  AND r.granularity = ${granularity:sqlstring}
  AND $__timeFilter(r.bucket)
  AND r.app_id::text IN ($app)
  AND r.release_sequence::text IN ($release)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1;

panels.title: Per release
panels.description: Sessions, fatal errors and Plux errors per release sequence.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT set_config('plux.organization_id', ${organization:sqlstring}, false);
SELECT t.rel AS "Release", t.sessions AS "Sessions", t.fatal AS "Fatal errors",
  t.plux AS "Plux errors", GREATEST(0, 1 - t.fatal::float8 / NULLIF(t.sessions, 0)) AS "Crash-free sessions"
FROM (
  SELECT r.release_sequence AS rel, SUM(r.events) FILTER (WHERE r.event_name = 'session_start') AS sessions,
    SUM(r.events) FILTER (WHERE r.event_name = 'fatal_error') AS fatal, SUM(r.events) FILTER (WHERE r.event_name = 'error') AS plux
  FROM analytics_rollups r
  WHERE r.organization_id = NULLIF(${organization:sqlstring}, '')::uuid
  AND r.granularity = ${granularity:sqlstring}
  AND $__timeFilter(r.bucket)
  AND r.app_id::text IN ($app)
  AND r.release_sequence::text IN ($release)
  GROUP BY 1
) t
ORDER BY 1 DESC;

panels.title: Per plugin
panels.description: Plux error events per plugin in the range. Events with no plugin are left out.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT set_config('plux.organization_id', ${organization:sqlstring}, false);
SELECT r.plugin_key AS "Plugin", SUM(r.events) FILTER (WHERE r.event_name = 'error') AS "Plux errors"
FROM analytics_rollups r
WHERE r.organization_id = NULLIF(${organization:sqlstring}, '')::uuid
  AND r.granularity = ${granularity:sqlstring}
  AND $__timeFilter(r.bucket)
  AND r.app_id::text IN ($app)
  AND r.release_sequence::text IN ($release)
  AND r.plugin_key <> ''
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 2 DESC
LIMIT 100;

panels.title: Per page
panels.description: Plux error events per page in the range. Events with no page are left out.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT set_config('plux.organization_id', ${organization:sqlstring}, false);
SELECT r.page AS "Page", SUM(r.events) FILTER (WHERE r.event_name = 'error') AS "Plux errors"
FROM analytics_rollups r
WHERE r.organization_id = NULLIF(${organization:sqlstring}, '')::uuid
  AND r.granularity = ${granularity:sqlstring}
  AND $__timeFilter(r.bucket)
  AND r.app_id::text IN ($app)
  AND r.release_sequence::text IN ($release)
  AND r.page <> ''
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 2 DESC
LIMIT 100;
